data.name: G1F1_001
data.value: It's incredible that an entire guild was built inside a tree,[pause=10] isn't it?

data.name: G1F1_002
data.value: This tree has been here as long as anyone can remember...[br]...But the guild itself is about as old I am.

data.name: G1F1_003
data.value: I'll have to tell you more about the town and its history later!

data.name: G1F1_004
data.value: But for now,[pause=10] we shouldn't keep {0} waiting.

data.name: G1F1_005
data.value: There's more things to see on the upper levels anyway![pause=0] C'mon!

data.name: G1F1_007
data.value: One more thing before we go up.

data.name: G1F1_008
data.value: I know all of this might be overwhelming and sudden given your amnesia,[pause=10] but...

data.name: G1F1_009
data.value: We shouldn't tell anyone that you were a human or that you lost your memory.

data.name: G1F1_010
data.value: I believe that you were a human at one point...

data.name: G1F1_011
data.value: But I don't think anyone else will.[pause=0] They'll just think we're crazy!

data.name: G1F1_012
data.value: And if that happens,[pause=10] we don't have a chance of being accepted to train here.

data.name: G1F1_013
data.value: So please,[pause=10] let's just keep it to ourselves for now...[pause=0] OK?

data.name: G1F1_014
data.value: I'm sorry that we need to keep it a secret.

data.name: G1F1_015
data.value: I promise we'll get to the bottom of your amnesia someday.

data.name: G1F1_016
data.value: Alright,[pause=10] let's not keep {0} waiting any longer.
